name: FFS_THEME
description: Contains all UI themes for the company.

columns.name: THEME_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the theme created in the system.

columns.name: CUSTOM
columns.description: Boolean showing if the theme is custom.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Custom theme name. Example: themeredwood.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Unique text identifier for the custom of module.

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Defines enabled or disabled theme. Values - 0 (disabled)), 1 - (enabled).

columns.name: UPLOAD_DATE
columns.description: Last theme import date and time.

columns.name: UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Last theme update date and time.

columns.name: COLOR
columns.description: Header block color value. Example: #FF6600.

columns.name: COPYRIGHT
columns.description: Custom text value for the copyright area.

columns.name: TOP_PAGE_TITLE
columns.description: Custom text value for the title.

columns.name: BIG_LOGO
columns.description: Metadata for uploaded big logo picture. Example: '80x80 PNG image 3.27 kB'.

columns.name: LOGIN_LOGO
columns.description: Metadata for uploaded login page picture. Example: '110x110 PNG image 5.53 kB'.

columns.name: SMALL_LOGO
columns.description: Metadata for uploaded small logo picture. Example: '80x80 PNG image 3.27 kB'.

columns.name: BG_PAGE
columns.description: Background color value. Example: #CCAA99.

columns.name: BG_SUBMIT
columns.description: Submit button color value. Example: #0572CE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
